primary_number: Rp 40.19T (2024 actual OJK health insurance GWP, all lines, from OJK statement to DPR, reported June 2025). No primary-source PA&H GWP forecast for 2025-2029 found. GlobalData 2025 projection (Rp 38.6T) is definitively below the 2024 OJK actual, confirming the forecast breakage flagged in the claim brief.
publisher: ANTARA News (Indonesia national wire service) reporting OJK statement to DPR, June 2025. Primary source of record is OJK itself (Kepala Eksekutif statement); ANTARA is a reliable secondary carrier of official OJK releases. OJK series confirmed: Rp 19.17T (2021) -> Rp 22.09T (2022) -> Rp 26.26T (2023) -> Rp 40.19T (2024), with 31.34M policies outstanding.
methodology_note: OJK Roadmap 2023-2027 (ojk.go.id, markitdown-fetched, confirmed authentic) sets only aggregate targets: insurance density Rp 2.4M/capita and penetration 3.2% by 2027. No PA&H-sector-level GWP forecast is published in that document. AAUI Q4 2024 report (aaui.or.id, markitdown-fetched) confirms general insurance total premi dicatat 2024 = Rp 112.9T (+8.7%); personal accident (general insurance line) contracted -5.7% in 2024 but health-claims were 13.8% of general insurance claims. GlobalData PA&H 2025 forecast (Rp 38.6T) is a single-vendor projection with no disclosed methodology, sourced from a press release only. The OJK series shows 53% YoY growth 2023->2024, giving a 3-year CAGR (2021-2024) of 28%, which makes GlobalData's 13.4% CAGR defensible directionally but their 2025 base figure (38.6T) is provably below the 2024 actual, invalidating the entire forward series on an absolute-Rp basis. ADB and World Bank were searched; no Indonesia PA&H GWP line-level forecast series was found.
